name: dev-kit
description: Vito's atom library for Claude Code: project-agnostic, agent-facing. 20 skills for planning, reporting, delegation, retrieval, and skill/context upkeep; 3 subagents (general-skills-executor, code-search, investigator); 3 PreToolUse hooks that push noisy skills into subagents and guard worktrees. The ship SOP lives in kox-agent-plugins, next to the infra it binds to.
